pureFuturesArbitrage._venuesNote: perp DEX 'aster' and 'lighter' are also supported (scan + trade)
pureFuturesArbitrage._feeRatesNote: optional per-venue taker override (%); omit to fetch per-symbol rates from exchange APIs
pureFuturesArbitrage._depthNote: depthCheckFailOpen=false blocks opens when the order book fetch fails (recommended for thin DEX books)
pureFuturesArbitrage._marginCheckNote: marginCheckFailOpen=false aborts opens when the balance API fails (fail-closed, recommended); true restores best-effort skip
pureFuturesArbitrage._fundingRecheckNote: re-fetch current funding rates right before order submission; abort when the spread collapsed below fundingRecheckMinSpreadPct (falls back to minSpreadPct) or the fetch fails while fundingRecheckFailOpen=false
pureFuturesArbitrage._feeAwareExitNote: watcher exits on NET edge (spread - taker fees) like the runner/backtest; false restores the legacy raw-spread exit
pureFuturesArbitrage._parallelLegsNote: open/close both perp legs concurrently to reduce mark_spread skew
